This is a rough visual estimate. I assumed about 130 g of the shredded beef and about 80 g of the mixed vegetables were eaten, since only small scraps of beef and a few vegetable pieces remain. The beef was taken as a fairly fatty braised cut at roughly 250 kcal per 100 g, and the vegetables at roughly 50 kcal per 100 g.
